fullPassage: Henry David Thoreau was born in Concord, Massachusetts in 1817. When he was 16, he entered Harvard College. After graduating, Thoreau worked as a schoolteacher but he quit after two weeks. In June of 1838 he set up a school with his brother John. However, he had hopes of becoming a nature poet. In 1845, he moved into a small self-built house near Walden Pond. At Walden, Thoreau did an incredible amount of reading. The journal he wrote there became the source of his most famous book, Walden. In his later life, Thoreau traveled to the Maine woods, to Cape Cod, and to Canada. At the age of 43, he ended his travels and returned to Concord. Although his works were not widely read during his lifetime, he never stopped writing, and his works fill 20 volumes.

✅ ③ 한 작가의 생애와 문학적 업적을 소개하는 인물 전기문 — 출생, 교육, 직업, 저서, 여행, 작품 활동
❌ ① 자연 보호의 중요성을 주장하는 논설문 — 주장 없음
❌ ② Walden Pond의 생태환경을 설명하는 보고서 — 장소 설명 아님
❌ ④ 19세기 미국 교육 제도를 비판하는 평론 — 교육 비판 없음
det.tip: 인물 전기문: 출생 → 교육 → 경력 → 업적 → 만년

questions.passage: Henry David Thoreau was born in Concord, Massachusetts in 1817. When he was 16, he entered Harvard College. After graduating, Thoreau worked as a schoolteacher but he quit after two weeks. In June of 1838 he set up a school with his brother John. However, he had hopes of becoming a nature poet. In 1845, he moved into a small self-built house near Walden Pond. At Walden, Thoreau did an incredible amount of reading. The journal he wrote there became the source of his most famous book, Walden. In his later life, Thoreau traveled to the Maine woods, to Cape Cod, and to Canada. At the age of 43, he ended his travels and returned to Concord. Although his works were not widely read during his lifetime, he never stopped writing, and his works fill 20 volumes.
questions.stem: 윗글에서 알 수 있는 Thoreau에 관한 사실로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 생전에 인정받지 못했지만 꾸준히 집필을 이어갔다는 Thoreau에 관한 사실
det.analysis:
✅ ① 생전에 인정받지 못했지만 꾸준히 집필 활동을 이어갔다 — 'not widely read during his lifetime, he never stopped writing'
❌ ② 교사 생활에 만족하여 오랫동안 재직했다 — quit after two weeks
❌ ③ Walden Pond에서 평생 살았다 — 돌아옴 (returned to Concord)
❌ ④ 자서전 한 권만 남겼다 — 20 volumes
det.tip: not widely read + never stopped writing = 인정 못 받았으나 꾸준히 집필
